sql: SELECT s.skill, count(DISTINCT s.posting_key) AS listings_mentioning FROM posting_skills s JOIN fct_posting f USING (posting_key) WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY s.skill ORDER BY listings_mentioning DESC LIMIT 10
